title: Caramel apple
hookLine: Caramel apples or toffee apples are whole apples covered in a layer of caramel.

items.name: Heavy cream, gelato base, or coconut milk
Crisp Honeycrisp or Granny Smith apples (thinly sliced)
Sweetened condensed milk or pure sugar

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {eu8_crm} and {eu8_flv} and keep toppings like {eu8_sug} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Whip Smooth & Fold Signature Flavor
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk or blend {eu8_crm}, {eu8_flv}, and {eu8_sug} until velvety smooth and aerated. Line your chilling pan or tray with parchment paper for easy lifting, and keep {eu8_crm}, {eu8_flv}, and {eu8_sug} measured and ready to combine.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {eu8_sug} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Chill Until Scoopable & Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into a chilled tin or glasses and freeze 2–3 hours (or serve immediately if blended with frozen fruit!). Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 4 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.creatorSecret: Chill your serving bowls in the freezer for 10 mins for cafe-style presentation.
